title: 第1118 章 我来跟他玩玩第1117 章 全押小
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: “你小子运气果然够强。”
鸡老眼皮狠狠跳动了下，他也是没想到第六把居然还是小，做了三年庄，还从来没连续开六把小。
“嘿嘿，运气好，运气好。”
秦关不好意思的挠了挠头，但心里却是惊讶不已。
难道是岁岁在暗中搞鬼，连续六把小这也太不寻常了吧？
“这是你的。”
这时，鸡老将两百三十四颗鸿蒙魂石推到秦关跟前。
秦关看着桌面上这么一大堆鸿蒙魂石，有些不敢相信，十颗本钱一会功夫就赚了两百多，这也太狠了。
“来啊，继续继续了！”
就在这时，鸡老突然又招呼众人：“谁都有运气好运气背的时候，连续六把小，这把该出大了，想要翻盘的赶紧下注了！”
“这把不押大小，押豹子，把两百三四颗全部押上去。”林岁岁嘴角勾起一抹坏笑，对秦关提醒道。
“若是赢了，会不会挨打啊？”
秦关有些害怕，悄悄给林岁岁传音。
“不会的，这里没人敢惹事，惹事会被踢出去，永远不能再进来。”林岁岁摆摆手。
“那行。”
秦关听后将两百三十四颗鸿蒙魂石全都推了出去：“这把我全押豹子。”
正在犹豫下注的众人心里猛的一惊，这家伙居然把两百多颗全部押了豹子。
“这要是真中了，不光通杀大小，而且庄家也要一赔十，给他两千三百四十颗鸿蒙魂石，而且还不能抽成！”现场有人惊呼出声。
所有人包括鸡老全都被秦关的操作惊住。
“小子，你确定全押豹子吗，豹子的几率多少天都不一定能出一回，若是输了，你这两百三十四颗可就全没了。”
鸡老看向秦关沉声提醒道。
秦关笑着摆了摆手：“没了就没了吧，全押豹子。”
“好！有魄力！”
鸡老没有多劝，他看向众人：“发财的机会来了，各位不用我多说了吧？”
“押大！”
“我押大！”
“全部押大！”
“哥们，能不能借我十颗，我想再拼一把，这样的机会很难得啊！”
鸡老话音还未落，现场数十号人突然一窝蜂的把鸿蒙魂石全都往大那边推。
先前犹豫的，一直没有参与的也全都加入了进来，现场氛围被彻底点燃。
“你们都押大，那我就押小，今天比较邪门，说不定还是小！”
“我也押小，要是再出小，就赢麻了！”
也有很多人押在了小上。
短短的时间内，赌桌上便积攒了一一千五百多颗鸿蒙魂石，所有人基本上把全部身家都押了出去。
“啧啧，好久没这么疯狂过了啊！”
看到众人热情高涨，鸡了啧了啧舌：“还有没有再押的了，没有我可要赖了哈！”
content_en:
"You're really lucky, boy."
Ji Lao's eyelids twitched fiercely. He didn't expect that the sixth hand was still small. He had been playing banker for three years and he had never opened six small hands in a row.
"Hey, good luck, good luck."
Qin Guan scratched his head embarrassedly, but he was surprised in his heart.
Could it be that Sui Sui is doing something secretly? Isn't it too unusual to play six games in a row?
"This is yours."
At this time, Mr. Ji pushed the two hundred and thirty-four Hongmeng Soul Stones to Qin Guan.
Qin Guan looked at such a large pile of Hongmeng Soul Stones on the table and couldn't believe it. He made more than two hundred for ten stones in a short time. This was too cruel.
"Come on, keep going!"
At this moment, Mr. Ji suddenly called everyone again: "Everyone has good luck. When he has six small hands in a row, this one is about to go big. If you want to make a comeback, bet quickly!"
"Don't bet on the size of this one, bet on the leopard, put all two hundred, thirty or four on it." Lin Suisui reminded Qin Guan with a wicked smile on his lips.
"If I win, will I get beaten?"
Qing Guan was a little scared and quietly sent a message to Lin Suisui.
"No, no one dares to cause trouble here. If you cause trouble, you will be kicked out and will never be able to come in again." Lin Suisui waved his hand.
"That's okay."
After hearing this, Qin Guan pushed out all the two hundred and thirty-four Hongmeng Soul Stones: "I'm going to put them all on the leopard."
Everyone who was hesitating to place their bets was shocked to find that this guy actually bet all of his more than two hundred bets on leopards.
"If he really wins, not only will he kill everyone, but the banker will also pay ten for each and give him two thousand three hundred and forty Hongmeng Soul Stones, and he won't get a commission!" Someone at the scene exclaimed.
Everyone, including Mr. Ji, was shocked by Qin Guan's operation.
"Boy, are you sure you're going all-in on the leopard? The chance of a leopard may not come out even once every few days. If you lose, you'll lose all your two hundred and thirty-four."
Ji Lao looked at Qin Guan and reminded him in a deep voice.
Qin Guan smiled and waved his hand: "If it's gone, it's gone. All in on Leopard."
"Good! Be brave!"
Mr. Ji didn't try to persuade him. He looked at everyone and said, "The opportunity to make a fortune has come. You don't need to say more, right?"
"Oshida!"
"I'll bet on you!"
"Bet all big!"
"Brother, can you lend me ten of them? I want to try again. This opportunity is rare!"
Before Mr. Ji finished speaking, dozens of people at the scene suddenly swarmed and pushed all the Hongmeng Soul Stones towards the big one.
Those who had been hesitant before and had not participated all joined in, and the atmosphere was completely ignited.
"You all bet on the big one, then I'll bet on the small one. Today is a bit weird, maybe it's the small one!"
"I'll also bet on the small one. If the small one comes out again, I'll win!"
There are also many people betting on Xiaoshang.
In a short period of time, more than 1,500 Hongmeng Soul Stones were accumulated on the gambling table, and everyone basically staked all their wealth.
"Tsk, tsk, I haven't been this crazy for a long time!"
Seeing everyone's enthusiasm, he clicked his tongue and said, "Are there any more bets? If you don't have me, you won't be able to do it!"
